item.title: Rahul and I gave a talk at the ATAP Great Lakes training event in Chicago!
item.description:
Rahul and I spoke at the ATAP Great Lakes Chapter’s Fifth Annual Training Event, held at the Willis Tower in Chicago. Our session was “When Technology Becomes a Tool of Abuse: Understanding Technology-Facilitated Intimate Partner Abuse”.

It was great bringing our IPV work to the threat assessment community!

item.title: I give a talk at the University of Cambridge security seminar!
item.description:
It was great meeting people there and share our experiences working on IPV preventing. Special thanks to Prof. Alice Hutchings for inviting me and Alex for organizing the talk.

Here is the recoding of the talk if you are interested: https://www.cl.cam.ac.uk/research/security/seminars/archive/video/2026-02-10-t243715.html
